# Prof. Dr. Maksuda Farida Akhtar (Mili) — Gynecologist, Obstetrician & Infertility Specialist

> Prof. Dr. Maksuda Farida Akhtar (Mili) is an FCPS-qualified gynecologist, obstetrician and infertility specialist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 20+ years of experience. She is Professor of Gynecology & Obstetrics at Dhaka Medical College & Hospital and holds a Fellowship in Infertility from the National University Hospital (NUH), Singapore. She treats infertility (IUI, IVF-ET), PCOS, endometriosis, uterine fibroids, menstrual and menopausal problems, manages normal and high-risk pregnancies, and performs laparoscopic and other gynecological surgery.

## Doctor Profile

- **Name:** Prof. Dr. Maksuda Farida Akhtar (Mili)
- **Qualifications:** MBBS, FCPS (Gynecology & Obstetrics)
- **Special training:** Fellowship in Infertility, National University Hospital (NUH), Singapore
- **Specialty:** Gynecology, Obstetrics & Infertility
- **Position:** Professor, Dept. of Gynecology & Obstetrics, Dhaka Medical College & Hospital
- **Experience:** 20+ years
- **Chamber 1:** Central Hospital Limited, House # 02, Road # 05, Green Road, Dhanmondi, Dhaka-1205 — 7:30 PM - 10:00 PM (Sat-Thu, closed Friday) — 02-9660015, 02-9660016, 02-41060800
- **Chamber 2:** Medilife Specialized Hospital Ltd, 4/5, Mitford Road, Mitford Tower, Dhaka-1100 — 3:00 PM - 6:00 PM (Sat-Thu, closed Friday & Govt. holidays) — 01715-303344, 09614-502299

## Services

- [Infertility Treatment](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/infertility-treatment): Fertility evaluation and treatment
- [IVF / IUI Treatment](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/ivf-iui-treatment): Intra-Uterine Insemination and IVF-ET
- [PCOS / PCOD Treatment](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/pcos-treatment): Hormonal and lifestyle management
- [Laparoscopic Surgery](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/laparoscopic-surgery): Minimally invasive gynecological surgery
- [Normal Vaginal Delivery (NVD)](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/normal-delivery): Safe delivery care
- [Pregnancy Care](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/pregnancy-care): Antenatal check-ups and high-risk pregnancy management
- [Gynaecological Surgery](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/gynae-surgery): Hysterectomy, myomectomy and other procedures
- [Endometriosis Treatment](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/endometriosis-treatment): Medical and surgical management
- [Menstrual Disorder Treatment](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/menstrual-disorder): Irregular, heavy or painful periods
- [Menopause Care](https://drtaponckdu.com/services/menopause-care): Symptom relief and long-term health
